reviews.text: I love Jameson Queen! I have a cat who is very anxious and reactive to being moved. I am always impressed by the care given to him, and the understanding they show me when I get anxious about how stressed he is. When I have concerns between appointments, they always respond promptly and are happy to discuss any concerns. I recommend Jameson Queen to all of my local pet owner friends. This clinic and the staff are exceptional in their all-around care and support of pets and their owners.

Had to bring my kitten in who was sick. I was very worried. And Dr Da Costa put me at ease so quickly.
Also my bill was not close to what I was expecting. In good way!!

I’ve been wanting to write a review for quite some time following the passing of our sweet baby girl Muffin. We see Dr. Noftall for both our cats and they are the most attentive, caring and thoughtful vet we’ve ever had the pleasure of seeing. When our Muffin was sick they left no stone unturned to try different remedies that alleviated her pain. The staff here are also kind and I especially want to call out Willow who always made Muffin feel safe and cared for. This is a great hospital who really cares about you furry babies. Thanks for all you do!
I can not say enough good things about Dr. Munn. He takes the time to evaluate your pet and listens to your concerns.  He is an amazing veterinarian and an exceptional human being.
Fantastic: professional and compassionate.
Dr. Munn is amazing! He is respectful, kind, caring and he'll ensure to answer all of your questions! He is caring for my hamster, Sparky, and he and his staff are awesome!

I can't say enough about this lovely group of people. We went through a few vets before we found like-minded people - kind and queer. They all go above and beyond in caring for our ol' girl. They are also one of the last few vets in the city that are independent and not been bought out by a corporation. Their prices are fair and are contentious of budgets and give lots of options.
Dr. Sam Munn and the team were very kind and compassionate. They did their best to help my rat, and I’m truly grateful. The little paw print they gave me means a lot to me.

The team and service at this veterinary practice are truly unparalleled, and the level of care is unmatched. We accidentally arrived at the wrong time (mum brain!), yet we were still seen within a short while and made to feel completely welcome by all the staff.

Spotty, our guinea pig, received exceptional care. Dr. Munn was not only thorough and professional, but also incredibly patient in answering all of my questions — as well as the many questions from my four-year-old daughter.

While waiting, we also witnessed the same gold-standard level of care being shown to other pets and their families, which further confirmed how special this practice is.

Both my daughter and I left feeling genuinely impressed and grateful. We aren’t local, but we will absolutely continue making the trip to this practice. Thank you Dr. Munn & The JQAH amazing Staff 💜🐹

Me and my ex partner brought our foster bunny, Miley (then our foster fail) into Jameson's and every time we were treated with such respect and kindness. They are amazing with the animals here. You can see the love, care, and compassion for them. They took such excellent care of Miley. The Vet is especially knowledgeable, kind, and he explains things in a precise manner. Our visits were great. We highly recommend this animal hospital for any of your fur babies! They will be in good hands, for sure. Thanks so much.

We moved our cats to this practice about a year ago, and it is the best move we made. The vets and techs are thoughtful, gentle, and attentive. The environment is as close to stress free as one can get from a vet visit. I wish we had switched sooner but am so, so glad we did.

There are no words for the gratitude I feel for Dr. Munn, Kirsti, Jen and everyone at Jameson Queen Animal Hospital. My two senior cats have a multitude of conditions and I the care given to them has truly been extraordinary. This clinic is an absolute treasure.

What an amazing place! Dr Munn is the absolute best! We have a Flemish giant rabbit which is very difficult to find a proper vet for, so Dr Munn is a treasure. I would give this more than five stars if that were possible.

This was my first time going to the vet with my hamster! The staff was amazing, so sweet, so caring and so kind. The doctor handled my hamster very well and was so caring! For an animal so tiny I’m very grateful to have a clinic that took care and examined my hamster! Thank you! 💗🐹 …

Dr. Munn and the staff at Jameson Queen are incredible. Extremely thorough consult where I felt completely heard and not rushed. First time I’ve had a vet grab a marker and draw out something so I could fully understand the issue (in this case narrow ear canals). The fact that Geo can walk my (fairly timid/nervous) dog into the treatment area and return her to me with a wagging tail…speaks volume about the vibe at this place!
Dr. Munn exudes kindness and caring.  Stellar independent veterinary practice.

Dr. Munn, who looks after my bunny, is very special. He really cares about bunnies and is a wealth of knowledge and experience. Such a kind man. Generally this vet’s office is a pleasure to deal with, from the moment you walk in.

For nearly 6 years I’ve been bringing my cat to this clinic- and then convinced my partner to bring his cat, and then two of my friends to bring their cats here- because I have consistently felt that they truly cared for my small pal.  I don’t always see the same doctor, but every one has been wonderful. I’m so glad Tarot and Damon have such a good care team on their side!
Absolutely terrible vet clinic. Do not communicate properly. Pay no attention to the quality of care for any pet

Dr Munn is amazing with my two bunnies. He’s seen them for routine checkups as well as emergency visits.

The entire staff have been wonderful to deal with, and I never feel rushed with all my questions about proper care.
They treated my cat with so much care here! Everyone was incredibly kind and knowledgeable. Highly recommend for anyone in the area.
Very kind on the phone, however, they are not taking new rat clients. It would be really nice if they could state this on the website.

Dr. Sarah provides excellent care. They are thorough and compassionate in their delivery of care, and create a very comfortable atmosphere that is welcoming to pets and people.

The Jameson Queen Animal Hospital team are great to work with and proactively follow up to make sure your pet gets the attention and recovery support needed.
My dog actually likes going to the vet because of them!!
So impressed with the care my bunny received here, I highly recommend this animal hospital :)

Always the best experience here! I’ve tried a couple vets all around Toronto and I’ve never felt as good as I feel at Jameson Queen with Dr Zimmerman.
My dog’s not from Canada and everywhere else I’ve felt like hospitals have diminished her care from her previous country, and tried to oversell services because of her background, but I haven’t felt it at all with this team. They’re always willing to listen to my concerns and be honest with me, price has never been an issue with them because before doing anything they always break it down to me and let me know my options, always prioritizing my pet’s wellbeing AND my budget.
Everyone at Jameson Queen is amazing and super sweet, my pug LOVES them, I can’t walk around their street because she will drag me and try to escape her harness to go in.
Couldn’t recommend Jameson Queen and Dr Zimmerman enough!

Dr. Munn is the best vet for exotic animals! He is compassionate and incredibly experienced with small animals. The team is also very kind & follow up if there are any concerns. Highly recommend for anyone in the downtown area looking for an amazing vet!
Fantastic and educational staff. Highly recommended!!

I also have a long overdue review to write. No other clinic compares to Jameson Queen. I have been a client for a few years and have brought many of my rats in for various issues (13 of them so far). Everyone has handled everything with compassion and expert knowledge. Dr. Munn in particular reaaaallly knows rats and spots things other vets have missed. I will not go anywhere else unless I absolutely have to. No other stranger has been able to get them to relax in their lap on the first try. He explains all of your options and leaves the treatment plan up to you--no pressure. The small animal community is incredibly lucky to have him and I will be bringing all of my future animals to him for life!

By far the best vet i’ve been to for my bunny!  Staff are friendly, knowledgeable and take excellent care of your pet with great attention to detail. My bunny had a surgery and it was a very smooth experience. The staff checked in by phone/email multiple times during his recovery to ensure he was okay. Excellent service!

I found this fantastic vet clinic when I was looking for travel documents for my cat.  They were fantastic, and less expensive than I had priced elsewhere.  They were thorough, friendly, understanding and compassionate.  I highly recommend this clinic.

This is a long overdue five-star review of JQAH.

Excellent care! Dr Munn really takes his time with the babies
Dr. Munn is the vet you would like to have for your pets.  He is patient, caring and professional.  The team is friendly and the clinic is pleasant to visit   (Nov 2023) …
Great, knowledgeable vets, always trust them to take care of my rabbit. Staff is friendly and they're always great with communication. …
I recently moved to the neighbourhood and have been getting my prescription cat food here. Always a great experience with the staff.
